claims.label: Front Shot, No Exit
claims.claim: The host says she is telling viewers 100% that Charlie Kirk was shot from the front and the bullet did not exit, and that she has fact-checked this from multiple sources.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain autopsy / medical examiner records and forensic bullet trajectory report to verify entry-side determination.

claims.label: Host Says Bullet Fragment Was Recovered From Charlie's Neck Near Shoulder Blade
claims.claim: The host says that, as she has fact-checked with multiple sources, a bullet fragment was recovered from Charlie's neck, in line with the shoulder blade near the spine.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against autopsy report and forensic pathology images for exact fragment location.

claims.label: Host Says No .30-06 Projectile Appears on Charlie Kirk's Death Certificate
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk's death certificate does not reflect a recovered .30-06 bullet, indicating that caliber was not recovered from his body.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain a certified copy of the death certificate and the medical examiner's full report.

claims.label: Kolvet Tweet Substance
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet posted a tweet claiming to relay a conversation with the surgeon who worked on Charlie, describing the bullet as having been stopped by Charlie's bone density.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original Kolbatz tweet and verify direct quotes and publication date.

claims.label: Surgeon Quoted on Bullet Stopped
claims.claim: Per Kolbatz's account, the surgeon stated the bullet should have exited, that people behind Charlie could have been killed, and characterized the outcome as "an absolute miracle."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the named surgeon (if given) and confirm statement through independent medical record review.

claims.label: Viral Clip Witness Account
claims.claim: A witness in the viral clip stated he was in the third row, heard a shot ring out, looked left and right, and saw Charlie slump with blood coming from the left side of his neck.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the witness and obtain a signed statement consistent with his on-camera description.

claims.label: Pusher Not TPUSA or UVU Affiliated
claims.claim: The host says she determined the man who physically pushed/shoved the witness in the viral clip was not a Turning Point USA employee, UVU student, or TPUSA student, but was brought in as a volunteer.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the pusher and verify his institutional affiliation at the time of the event.

claims.label: Cooper Brown Leadership Institute Affiliation
claims.claim: Cooper Brown stated on Fox News that he works for the Leadership Institute, which partners with TPUSA, Young Americans for Liberty, and Students for Life on college campuses.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Leadership Institute employment records and verify the organization's claimed coalition roles.

claims.label: Cooper Brown Fox News Night-Of Interview
claims.claim: The host says Cooper Brown appeared on Jesse Watters' Fox News program the night of the shooting, and plays a clip of that appearance.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify timestamp and full segment via Fox News archives.

claims.label: Cooper Brown Fox News Next-Day Interview
claims.claim: The host says Cooper Brown appeared on Fox News again the day after the shooting, and plays a clip of that appearance.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify timestamp and full segment via Fox News archives.

claims.label: Cooper Brown Microphone Role
claims.claim: Cooper Brown stated his event responsibility was managing the microphone – raising and lowering it for student questioners.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference event staff logs or volunteer rosters provided by organizers.

claims.label: Cooper Brown Resume – Southern New Hampshire University
claims.claim: Cooper Brown's public resume lists attendance at a small college in New Hampshire (per host: Southern New Hampshire University) with a politics major.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull registrar verification or alumni records (subject to FERPA limits).

claims.label: Same-Name SNHU Graduate Discrepancy
claims.claim: The host says that at the small New Hampshire college she found someone with Cooper Brown's name, but it was a girl who graduated in the year his resume gives; separately, the Phoenix-based number she was given links to somebody else, aged 32, with the same last name, and she says she does not know who he is.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm whether the female same-name individual is or is not the same person through independent records.

claims.label: Jason Chaffetz Eyewitness – Close, Ahead
claims.claim: Jason Chaffetz stated on Fox News that, "if I had to guess," the shot looked to him like it was "in close proximity straight ahead."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm full segment and any subsequent Chaffetz statements on the topic.

claims.label: Two-Shot Witness Account – Lyman Footage
claims.claim: Two women shown in Phil Lyman's footage of the building exterior stated they heard two shots.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and re-interview the two women, and compare against Phil Lyman's published footage metadata.

claims.label: Host Says Dr. Deirdre Amaro Was Announced as New Utah State Medical Examiner in May 2024
claims.claim: The host says that, per a tip she received, Dr. Deirdre Amaro was announced as the new Utah State Medical Examiner in May 2024, with prior work history in Missouri (and, she thinks, California).
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Utah state announcement and prior employment records.

claims.label: Israeli Individual Listed as Caldera Founder
claims.claim: A web listing identified an Israeli individual as the founder of Caldera Engineering, though host states this could not be independently corroborated.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Utah LLC formation records (pre-digitization, requires in-person request) and Israeli business registries.

claims.label: Host Says Caldera Engineering Was Established in 1997
claims.claim: The host says Caldera Engineering was established in 1997.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Utah Division of Corporations records and trademark filings.

claims.label: Host Says Caldera Engineering Employee Has Professional Acting Background
claims.claim: The host says that, per a tip she received, a person employed at Caldera Engineering has a professional acting background (theater school, plays), with no engineering background before the resume listing.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via LinkedIn / professional profile cross-checks.

claims.label: Caldera Early Trademark Lawyer – Tyler Bowyer Connection
claims.claim: The lawyer Caldera Engineering used in its early trademark filings in Arizona was the same lawyer introduced to the host by Tyler Bowyer of Turning Point USA.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Arizona trademark filings and confirm attorney of record.

claims.label: Host Says Plane N1098L Was a Military Aircraft
claims.claim: The host says a plane with tail number N1098L, which she says people have recognized as military and which had been used in the military, flew over Utah around the time of the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull FAA registry for N1098L and prior military tail assignments.

claims.label: Host Says Plane N1098L Was Owned/Contracted by Las Vegas Aviation LLC
claims.claim: The host says Plane N1098L was owned by, or contracted through, Las Vegas Aviation LLC.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm ownership via FAA registry and Nevada Secretary of State filings for Las Vegas Aviation LLC.

claims.label: Host Says Plane N1098L Flew From Texas to Utah Around the Time of the Shooting
claims.claim: The host says Plane N1098L departed Texas and routed to Utah around the time of the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull ADS-B Exchange / FlightAware historical track for N1098L on the date.

claims.label: Plane 888 – Maxfield Affiliation
claims.claim: The host says a second plane, which she remembers as having '888' in its identification, is the plane of Derek Maxfield and his wife Shelaine Maxfield, who she says sold a beauty company.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify aircraft registration, ownership, and any link to Derek/Shelaine Maxfield.

claims.label: Host Says Plane 888's Intended Destination Was Page, Arizona
claims.claim: The host says Plane 888's intended destination was Page, Arizona.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via filed flight plan and FBO records.

claims.label: Host Says Plane 888's ADSB Transponder Appeared to Turn Off
claims.claim: The host says the ADSB transponder on plane 888 appeared to turn off during the flight.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull historical ADSB / radar track for the aircraft on the date.

claims.label: Kash Patel – Plane Never Stopped Transponding
claims.claim: The host says Kash Patel told them plane 888 never stopped transponding.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Kash Patel's original statement (interview, press release, social media post) for verbatim wording.

claims.label: Derek Maxfield – ATC Approval to Stop Transponding
claims.claim: The host says Derek Maxfield stated on Instagram that the air traffic control center had agreed they could stop transponding.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Maxfield's original Instagram post and any corroborating ATC logs.

claims.label: Host Says Plane 888 Changed Its FBO Destination at the Last Minute
claims.claim: The host says Plane 888 changed its FBO destination at the last minute, from Millionaire to Signature.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via FBO records at Page, Arizona (Millionaire and Signature).

claims.label: Host Says Signature FBO Person Gave Contradicting Statements
claims.claim: The host says that a person at the Signature FBO initially confirmed that the plane had made multiple trips in recent days, then reversed to state no plane had ever landed there.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the employee and obtain signed statement; cross-check Signature FBO ramp logs.

claims.label: Host Says Josh Hammer Released Text Messages
claims.claim: The host says Josh Hammer publicly released text messages between himself and Charlie Kirk in response to the prior episode, and reads them.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify release date and source channel.

claims.label: Text Message Content – Standard Exchange
claims.claim: The released texts include a "thank you for your help guys" message (attributed to Charlie Kirk) and a reply the host assumes is Josh Hammer's asking what Charlie's "first stop tomorrow" was.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full thread (including timestamps and any prior context messages) and verify against the surrounding calendar of Charlie Kirk's campus events.

claims.label: Trump Truth Social – Israel/Hamas Phase One Announcement
claims.claim: Donald Trump posted on Truth Social announcing that Israel and Hamas had signed off on the first phase of a peace plan, including hostage release and partial troop withdrawal.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact post text and time stamp via Trump's Truth Social archive.

claims.label: Jared Kushner Harvard Speech – Gaza "Waterfront Property"
claims.claim: At a Harvard appearance on February 15, 2024 (per the host), Jared Kushner said Gaza's "waterfront property" could be very valuable and that "from Israel's perspective, I would do my best to move the people out and then clean it up."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify full Harvard event recording and transcript.

claims.label: Host Says Matt Walsh Found Kirk's Text "Too on the Nose"
claims.claim: The host says Matt Walsh thought Charlie Kirk's text messages were fake because the sentence about leaving the pro-Israel cause felt "too on the nose"; the host adds her own view that it suggests Charlie had been pushed to write it.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify clip source and full Matt Walsh segment.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Was Not in Viral Push Video
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet was not the man in the viral push video, and that she spoke to him and he flew into Utah after the shooting and was not on the ground.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Kolbatz's travel timeline via receipts or communications.

claims.label: Host identifies show community as Decentralized Intelligence Agency
claims.claim: The host states that the show / audience operates as the Decentralized Intelligence Agency (or close variant), a crowd-sourced tip network opposing centralized intel.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve as brand / network framing claim; cross-link M-12 meme occurrence when present.
claims.transcript_snippet: ...ks explain to us what it is that you know in this decentralized intelligent agency, given the information that I am telling you, okay? That it had it unless we have a bulle...

claims.label: Host Says This Is Her Last Show Before a Break
claims.claim: The host says this episode is her last show before she takes a break from the program.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the episode release schedule on the channel with the break the host announces.
claims.transcript_snippet: Last show until I take a much-needed break, and it's going to be a good one.

claims.label: Host Says She Verified the Neck Injury Information but Will Not Name Her Sources
claims.claim: The host says she has positively verified something about Charlie Kirk's neck injury, but that she cannot say who gave her the information or which parties were involved, so as not to get anyone in trouble.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to document, privately or via an intermediary, the number and type of sources behind the neck-injury finding; compare with the autopsy and death-certificate record.
claims.transcript_snippet: I can't tell you exactly who the information came from or which parties were involved in giving me this information cuz I don't want to get anybody in trouble

claims.label: Kolvet Tweet Says Coroner Found the Bullet Just Beneath the Skin
claims.claim: As read aloud by the host, the Andrew Kolvet tweet says the bullet likely would have killed people standing behind Charlie and that the coroner found it just beneath the skin.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Kolvet tweet and compare it with the autopsy findings; ask the Utah medical examiner's office where the projectile was recovered.
claims.transcript_snippet: It likely would have killed those standing behind him, too. In the end the coroner did find the bullet just beneath the skin.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Sat on the Bullet Finding for a Little Over a Week
claims.claim: The host says she fact-checked the front-shot and no-exit finding with multiple sources and had been sitting on it for a little over a week before airing it.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish when the host first received the finding, for example from her own messages with sources, and compare with earlier episodes that touched the bullet.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have fact-checked this information from multiple sources now. I've actually been sitting on this for a little bit over a week.

claims.label: Host Says Medical Examiners Tell Her Known Guns and Bullets Appear on the Death Certificate
claims.claim: The host says that from conversations with quite a few medical examiners she understands that when the gun and the bullet are known, they are reflected on the death certificate.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Utah and other state medical examiners whether weapon and projectile details are entered on death certificates, and pull Utah's death-certificate standards.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've spoken to quite a few, but when the gun and the bullet are known, they are reflected onto the death certificate, okay?

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Was Shot With a Completely Different, Smaller Gun
claims.claim: The host says that because the neck did not blow apart and the bullet did not exit, Charlie was shot with a completely different kind of gun from the rifle the authorities named, which would have gone through about seven necks.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the autopsy, wound-ballistics and projectile reports and have an independent forensic pathologist assess the wound and recovered fragment against the .30-06 and smaller calibers.
claims.transcript_snippet: It means that he was shot with a completely different kind of gun, obviously, okay? The kind where this would make sense that it didn't cut through him.

claims.label: Host Says On-the-Ground Witnesses Reported Multiple Shots but Got No Mainstream Interviews
claims.claim: The host says witnesses on the ground insisted they heard multiple shots, but those people were not the ones given mainstream media interviews.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect named witness statements and any police interview summaries on the number of shots heard, and compare with which witnesses the networks interviewed.
claims.transcript_snippet: there were people who were insisting, by the way, they were on the ground, the witnesses that were insisting that they heard multiple shots.

claims.label: Host Argues the Viral Witness Looked Left and Right After the Shot, Not Back
claims.claim: The host says the witness in the viral clip described looking left and then right after the shot, and argues that if a high-powered rifle had fired from 250 yards behind he would probably have looked back first.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the witness and interview him about where he was standing and which direction the sound seemed to come from; get the full unedited clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: if a shot, a high-powered rifle, came from 250 yards behind you, you'd probably look back first, right?

claims.label: Host Says a Friend of the Man She Tried to Identify Said He Was Told Not to Speak to Media
claims.claim: The host says that after she posted a picture asking to identify a person from the viral clip, his friend left a nasty comment and then messaged her privately that, paraphrasing, he does not want to speak to media because he has been instructed not to, having got the Turning Point chapter into trouble before.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the private message exchange and identify who instructed the man and which TPUSA chapter had earlier been in trouble over media comments.
claims.transcript_snippet: He doesn't want to speak to media because he's been instructed not to speak to media because he's gotten the Turning Point chapter into trouble before for speaking out in the media

claims.label: Host Says the Excuse Given Was a TPUSA Text Telling People Not to Speak to Media
claims.claim: The host says the excuse offered for why the man was shut down was that Turning Point USA had sent a text saying nobody should speak to the media.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TPUSA for any message sent to chapters or volunteers about speaking to media on 9/10, and ask the people who received it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA what sent her on a text and said, "Nobody speak to the media." That's what That was his excuse, by the way, for why he shut that guy up.

claims.label: Host Says Campus Stops Are Normally Run by the Host School's Chapter
claims.claim: The host says that in her experience of many campus stops, it is typically the chapter of the host school that does everything, which is why she found the volunteer's role odd.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the UVU event planning documents showing which organizations ran stage, security and volunteers for the 9/10 event.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've done a lot of campus stops, and typically it's the chapter of that school that does everything.

claims.label: Host Says the Man Who Shoved the Witness Is Cooper, Who Held the Microphone
claims.claim: The host says the man who did the shoving is a young man named Cooper, who went on Fox News that night to give eyewitness testimony, and who she says was holding the microphone when the shot rang out.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the viral shoving footage with Cooper Brown's Fox News appearances to confirm the two are the same person.
claims.transcript_snippet: that young man, whose name is Cooper, and I'm very comfortable telling you this because well, he went on Fox News that very night to provide eyewitness testimony to exactly what he heard and what he saw

claims.label: Host Says an Emailer Claiming to Be Cooper's Cousin Lives in Phoenix
claims.claim: The host says one emailer claimed to be Cooper Brown's cousin and supplied his number, and that this cousin lives in Phoenix, Arizona.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the original email and verify the sender's relationship to Cooper Brown without publishing private contact details.
claims.transcript_snippet: One email said, "Hey, I'm actually his cousin and here is his number." Now, I noticed that that cousin happens to live in Phoenix, Arizona.

claims.label: Host Says the Number She Was Given Was Phoenix-Based and Tied to a 32-Year-Old With the Same Last Name
claims.claim: The host says the number given to her was Phoenix-based and was linked to another person, aged 32, with the same last name, which she says she cannot explain.
claims.investigative_direction: Reconcile the number's carrier and listing records with Cooper Brown's stated Utah and New Hampshire history; the existing C-1437 may blend this with the same-name graduate.
claims.transcript_snippet: a Phoenix-based number. So, I'm going, "Who is this person? And why is it linking that number to somebody else who's 32 years old and has that same last name?"

claims.label: Host Says Holding the Microphone Is Normally an Honor Given to Hard-Working TPUSA Students
claims.claim: The host says holding the microphone at Utah events is supposed to be an honor, that TPUSA students work hard on the events, and that it is odd they gave the microphone to a volunteer.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the UVU event volunteer roster and microphone assignment, and ask UVU chapter students who normally held the microphone.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's supposed to be like kind of an honor at Utah events. Turning Point USA kids work really hard to put these events on.

claims.label: Host Says the Rifle Shot Was Real but Did Not Hit Charlie
claims.claim: The host says the sound people heard was a recognizable rifle shot, but that Charlie was not hit with that rifle, and that no medical examiner's report or death certificate says otherwise.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the autopsy and ballistics findings and the audio of the shot sequence to test whether the audible rifle shot and the fatal wound match.
claims.transcript_snippet: We definitely did hear a very recognizable sound of a rifle shot. But I'm telling you that Charlie wasn't hit with that rifle.

claims.label: Host Says a Tip Email Urged Her to Look Further Into the Medical Examiner
claims.claim: The host says she received an emailed tip insisting that the medical examiner is a person to look into further, and that the examiner is Dr. Deirdre Amaro.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the tip email for its basis and verify the examiner's career record independently.
claims.transcript_snippet: this person an email insisted to me that this is somebody that we should look further into. That's the medical examiner.

claims.label: Host Asks Viewers With Knowledge of the Medical Examiner to Email Tips
claims.claim: The host asks viewers who know the Utah medical examiner personally or have a story about her to send it to the tip email address.
claims.investigative_direction: Record tip volume and follow-up in later episodes where the host cites emailed tips about the examiner.
